info.description: ONE MEMBER OF THE ADVISORY COUNCIL, as the school's board prints them. ⚠⚠ THESE ROWS ARE NOT DRAWN ON THE PAGE — the board IMAGE is what a visitor sees. They are the image's text alternative: the page builds the alt text from them, which is the only form these fifteen names exist in for a screen reader, for Google, and for anyone trying to copy one. ⚠⚠ SO THEY MUST BE CHANGED WHENEVER THE BOARD IMAGE IS REPLACED. Upload a new board and leave these rows alone and the page will read out last year's council over this year's picture, with nothing on screen to show it.

name.description: As printed — 'Prof. Dr. Raghwendra Pratap Singh'. It wraps onto two lines on the board; that is the artwork running out of width, not two lines of meaning.

office.description: The BOLD line under the name, where the board sets one — 'Chairperson', 'Retd. IAS', 'Professor & Head'. Most members have none.

affiliation.description: The lighter line beneath, as printed — including the board's own inconsistencies, such as 'Vanarasi' under Mrs. Amrita Burman where every other row spells it Varanasi, and the full stop after 'BHU, Varanasi.'
